svg.title: Picking quality vs. latency
svg.desc: Higher is better. Each model has three threshold settings at the same measured latency or cost. Circle is 0.30, diamond is 0.40, and filled square is 0.50. Latency is median elapsed time per task. The benchmark page contains the exact values.
svg.text: Higher is better. Each model has three threshold settings at the same measured latency or cost.
Overlapping markers can share a score or latency; see the exact-value table.
